Residential Air Conditioner Spare Parts

Indicative market prices for common split and window AC spare parts in India, with guidance on what to share before a replacement.

This page helps you understand roughly what common AC spare parts cost before you call a technician. Prices are collected from public online part listings and published service rate cards, and are shown as ranges because the final price depends on your AC brand, model, capacity and the part's availability. Share your AC details with BOBBY on WhatsApp and we will confirm the correct part and the replacement cost for your unit.

Last price review: 18 November 2026

Important

Prices below are approximate market references, not BOBBY's fixed selling prices. Spare part prices do not include inspection, labour, gas charging, brazing, installation or other service charges, which are quoted separately after diagnosis.

AC Spare Parts Price Guide

Indicative prices only. Actual cost varies by brand, model, tonnage, inverter or non-inverter type, genuine or compatible part, and stock. Final price is confirmed only after inspection.

How to Identify the Correct AC Spare Part

Most wrong-part problems come from guessing. These steps help us match the exact part the first time.

  1. 1

    Read the rating label

    The sticker on the side of the indoor unit and on the outdoor unit shows the brand, model number, capacity, refrigerant (R32, R410A or R22) and voltage.

  2. 2

    Check inverter or non-inverter

    Inverter ACs use different PCBs, compressors and fan motors. A non-inverter part will not work in an inverter unit, and the reverse.

  3. 3

    Copy the part's own markings

    Capacitors show MFD and voltage, motors show wattage and rotation, PCBs carry a part code. Matching these values matters more than the brand name.

  4. 4

    Photograph before removing

    Take photos of the part, its label and its wiring from two angles. This avoids wiring mistakes when the new part is fitted.

  5. 5

    Get the fault diagnosed first

    Symptoms often overlap — a dead outdoor unit can be a capacitor, contactor, PCB or wiring fault. Replacing a part without testing wastes money.

Safety note

AC units carry mains voltage, and capacitors can hold a charge even after the power is switched off. Compressor, coil, valve and gas work involves pressurised refrigerant and brazing. Please do not open the AC or attempt these replacements yourself — have a trained technician do it.

AC Spare Parts – Frequently Asked Questions

Are these BOBBY's fixed prices?

No. They are approximate market prices collected from public sources for reference. BOBBY confirms the actual part price for your AC after inspection and before any work starts.

Do the prices include labour or installation?

Not as a rule. Online part prices are for the part only. Some published rate cards include fitting, and those items are tagged as rate-card prices. Inspection, labour, gas charging and brazing are quoted separately.

Why is a price shown as a range?

The same part differs by brand, model, tonnage, rating, and whether it is genuine or compatible. Different sellers also price differently, so a range is more honest than a single number.

Is PCB repair the same as a new PCB?

No. PCB repair fixes your existing board at component level and usually costs less. A new original board is model-specific and priced on request. A universal PCB kit is a cheaper alternative but changes the remote and some features.

Do you fit refurbished compressors?

Only if you ask for one and approve it. Refurbished compressors are listed separately on this page so the condition is always clear, and their warranty terms differ from new parts.

Will a universal or compatible part fit my AC?

Not always. No part fits every AC. Fit depends on size, rating, connectors and the control system, so we check your model before recommending a compatible part.

Can I buy a part from you and fit it myself?

BOBBY supplies parts as part of a repair visit, not as an online shop. For your safety, electrical and refrigeration parts should be fitted and tested by a technician.

Do you use genuine (OEM) parts?

Where available and approved by you, yes. Otherwise we offer a good-quality compatible part and tell you clearly which one is being fitted before we fit it.

How long does a part replacement take?

Small parts such as capacitors, sensors or a remote are often done in the same visit. Model-specific PCBs, motors, coils or compressors may take extra days depending on stock.

Which areas do you cover?

BOBBY serves homes in Narasaraopet and nearby areas. Message us on WhatsApp with your location to confirm a visit.
